IC1: - Stage III periodontitis patient having at least one tooth [AND] with one wall [OR] or combined1- to 2-wall intraosseous defect ≥ 3 mm deep (assessed by trans-gingival probing, [OR] radiographic examination) [AND] with clinical attachment level (CAL) ≥ 5mm and pocket depth (PD) ≥ 6 mm.
IC2: - Defect [NOT] not extending to a root furcation area
IC5: - [NOT] No history of intake of antibiotics [OR] or other medications affecting the periodontium in the previous 6 months.
IC6: - [NOT] No periodontal therapy carried out in the past 6 months.
IC7: - Able to sign an informed consent form.
IC8: - Patients age between 25 and 50 years old.
IC9: - Patients who are cooperative, motivated, and hygiene conscious.
IC10: - Systemically free according to Cornell Medical Index
